Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerClaimsP:
How many vehicles one account can own at the same time.
0 stops new claims; vehicles already claimed stay protected.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerMaxMemb: How many named players an owner can share one vehicle with.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerClaimDi: How close to the centre of the vehicle a player must stand to claim, unclaim or re-issue it.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerAllowFa:
When enabled, owners can let members of their faction use a vehicle.
Sharing pauses automatically if the faction is renamed, disbanded or gets a new leader.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerInactiv:
0 (default) turns this off.
Otherwise, when an owner has not logged in for this many days they get a warning, and after the grace period their vehicles start being released.
Days between the inactivity warning and the start of the release.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerRelease:
A vehicle reported as lost, or released for inactivity, stays protected for this long.
If the server sees the vehicle again in that time, the release is cancelled.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerTombsto: How long released, lost or destroyed vehicles stay in the owner's list before they are cleared.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerNameMax: Maximum length of a custom vehicle name. Chinese and Japanese characters use 3 bytes each.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerVirtual:
Owners and players they allow to drive can unlock, open without triggering the alarm and start their claimed vehicles without the physical key.
Off keeps the vanilla key rules.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerWatchdo: What the server does when someone sits in a claimed vehicle without permission. The server checks every occupant regularly; a modified client can still sit in the seat for a moment.
How often the server checks each online player for sitting in a claimed vehicle without permission.
Remove the player from the vehicle
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerRebindD: Claims imported from Mysterious Vehicle Claim Key become real claims the first time the server sees the vehicle. Imported claims not matched after this many days are dropped and written to the audit log.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerPaidSlo:
Needs Minidoracat Economy on a dedicated server.
Players can buy extra claim slots that never expire. Off stops new sales; slots already bought still count.
Prices can also be changed in the Economy admin window; both stay in sync.
Currency id used to pay for a permanent slot, for example survivor or cat.
Price of one permanent claim slot.
Paid slots: permanent slots per player
How many permanent slots one player can buy in total. 0 stops new purchases; slots already bought still count.
Maintained by Economy to stop stale sandbox settings from overwriting a newer slot plan. Do not edit manually; change prices and rental terms here or on Economy's Integration Plans admin page.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerLeaseSl:
Needs Minidoracat Economy on a dedicated server.
Players can rent extra claim slots for a set number of days. Off stops new rentals and renewals; running rentals keep their paid time.
Currency id used to pay for a rental, for example survivor or cat.
How many claim slots one rental gives. Renewing extends the same slots; it does not add more.
How many days one rental or renewal lasts.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerLeaseGr:
After a rental ends, its slots still count for this many hours so the player can renew.
When rented slots stop counting, vehicles already claimed stay protected; only new claims beyond the limit are refused.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerLeaseRe: Rented slots: reminder before the end (hours)
How long before a rental ends the player is reminded.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleManagerLeaseAu:
Players may choose to renew automatically. It stays off until the player turns it on and confirms the price.
If the price or terms change, automatic renewal pauses until the player confirms again.
